scope: Change only room geometry, placement, connectors, and geometry-related explanation. Preserve room roles, progression, and gates.

01.layout: An irregular landing follows the riverbank. The paved arrival apron stays broad; a side dock carries the boat.

02.layout: A skewed, splayed gatehouse opens into a broad diagonal combat lane. The two low blocks sit outside the entry and exit lines.

03.layout: An oval court wraps a small root island. The two branches leave different curved shoulders; the perimeter remains a broad combat circuit.

04.layout: The barracks fan outward from an oblique rear wall. Bunks follow the wall, while the wider eastern apron supports flanking and the court entrance.

05.layout: A rounded forge bay joins a straight counter wing. The north-to-south walking lane stays outside the work area.

06.layout: A wide L-shaped cloister surrounds an open garden corner. Its bend breaks a long firing line without turning the combat space into a narrow maze.

07.layout: A round recovery sanctuary has four short vestibules. The fountain sits north of the crossing; the return lever remains in the south vestibule.

08.layout: A crescent gallery follows an eroded water inlet. The inward bay creates a clear shoreline; the dry western band connects both doors without a thin bridge.

09.layout: A faceted ritual vault has splayed corners and a broad open center. Edge monuments frame the encounter rather than divide it into corridors.

10.layout: A small rounded apse holds the reward. Its western vestibule still meets the gated return into the sanctuary.

11.layout: A cruciform hall combines a north apse, a broad transept, and a clear central nave. Side arms offer flanking space instead of decorative dead corridors.

12.layout: An asymmetrical, multi-lobed grotto forms the finale. Recessed pools and rocky shoulders stay peripheral; a large continuous dry center supports the Chieftain encounter.

13.layout: A tapered crypt widens beyond its concealed threshold. The shape suggests an older excavation, not another standard reward box.

14.layout: A compact dogleg stair folds around the rock face. It is an exit landmark, not an extra rectangular combat chamber.
